Cell.Text: S|I don't know. I'll just go wherever you are going. I will repay your kindness by fighting alongside you. Surely that's an offer you can't refuse?

Node.Caption: JJSofiaQuestWhereTakeYou: Where do you want me to take you?

Cell.Text: S|I don't. I thought I would help you out.

Node.Caption: JJSofiaQuestHelpYouOut: So, if you are so tough and independent, why do you need my help?

Cell.Text: Well I was hoping you would kind of keep me company. Look I know it sounds weird but it's no fun on my own. | You can tell me to leave if you want but surely you can at least give me a chance?

Node.Caption: JJSofiaQuestDidntAskYou: I didn't ask for any help though?

Cell.Text: S|Am I not allowed out on my own now? I had a little too much to drink. So what? I guess I must have passed out. | I hope I didn't cause too much trouble. Actually I'm not really that bothered.

Node.Caption: JJSofiaQuestWhyOnYourOwn: So why were you out on your own and why do you stink of booze?

Cell.Text: S|Of course I'm alright. Don't start fussing over me, I'm more than capable of handling myself.
S|What?! Ugh I have no idea. My memory is a little fuzzy. If you happen to have any I would appreciate it. | Oh and stop staring at my body. It's like you've never seen a semi-naked woman before.
G|What you really mean is that you don't like competition. Anyway fine, I get it. People do get a little jealous of me but I've come to accept it. | If you change your mind come and find me.

[S] Is that it? Aren't you going to flex your muscles and tell me how great you are? That seems to be the customary greeting in Skyrim. | Anyway, there's no suppose about it. Everyone could use someone a little more like me.

Node.Caption: JJSofiaQuestISupposeUseBackup: I suppose I could use some backup.

Cell.Text: [S] Well, we will see about that. I could have you wrapped around my little finger in minutes. Either that or I could have your head as a trophy. | Anyway thanks, I'll do what I can to help but don't push your luck.

Node.Caption: JJSofiaQuestYouWillDoFavours: OK, but you will be doing me a lot of favours in return.

Cell.Text: [S] Haha, you are so funny. I'm just being honest and anyone who says otherwise is clearly jealous. | Can you name someone better than me? I didn't think so. Anyway thanks, I guess.

Node.Caption: JJSofiaQuestYouAreModest: You are quite modest then? Fine, welcome aboard.

Cell.Text: Yeah well that's because... OK fine, if you take me with you I will make it worth your while. | You won't find anyone tougher than me in Skyrim. Not to mention as good looking.
Wait! Don't leave!.. I'm injured... uh yes injured. You have to take me with you otherwise I might die and you wouldn't want that on your conscience.

Node.Caption: JJSofiaQuestInjured: Um... OK. I have to go now.

Cell.Text: [S] What? Where am I? Ugh my head! Oh it's you! Uh I mean what? No I've never seen you before. I have no idea who you are. | It's not like I've been stalking you or anything.
